events.title: Iran War Escalation

However, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) may also see increased buying activity as investors seek to diversify their portfolios. The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) may be shorted as investors become more risk-tolerant and seek higher returns.

timeFrame.note: Monitor news and adjust positions accordingly
